goal: Evaluate final reliability threshold and close out mission.

issuesFound.description: Phase 4 cycle script used invalid task names (list_files, list_repos) that workers don't recognize. Workers return {error:'Unknown task'} for unrecognized task types. Fix: use valid task names (analyze, status, list-issues, list-files)
issuesFound.fix: Corrected cycle script uses worker-supported task names only. Task type validation should be added to dispatch_task plugin tool.

issuesFound.description: result-processor.js was not running at start of Phase 4. Workers publish to a2a:coordination channel but without a subscriber, no audit entries are written. Tasks complete but are undetectable.
issuesFound.fix: Started result-processor manually. Should be managed by start-workers.sh or a supervisor.

issuesFound.description: Two sets of typed workers were running simultaneously (from hub restart + manual start). Killed duplicates. Single set is sufficient.
issuesFound.fix: Worker ctl script should track PIDs and prevent duplicates.

issuesFound.description: CHAOS TEST CONFIRMED 07:14: sprint + devops workers killed — tasks LOST. Sprint worker had built-in pending mechanism; typed workers used BLPOP. FIX: BaseWorker.pollTask() now BRPOPLPUSH → a2a:pending:{agentId}:{ts}:{rand} with 60s TTL; Supervisor (scripts/hub-sprint-supervisor.js) monitors both key patterns and re-queues stale tasks.
issuesFound.fix: RESOLVED. Chaos test 20:33 UTC: sprint task (sleep 20) → worker claimed → kill -9 → supervisor recovered (heartbeat 65s old) → re-queued → new worker completed. Audit: chaos-fix2-1775507435847 status=completed duration=20004ms.
